ctu1.sentence: The application must include documents such as the loan sanction letter, registration certificate, and a copy of the project report.

ctu2.sentence: The application can be submitted online through the official website of the Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises.

ctu1.sentence: After submission, the application will be reviewed by the concerned authorities.

ctu2.sentence: If approved, the interest subsidy will be credited directly to the bank account of the entrepreneur.

ctu1.sentence: This subsidy is applicable for a maximum loan amount of ₹1 crore.

ctu2.sentence: The maximum subsidy amount that can be availed under this scheme is ₹5 lakh per enterprise.

ctu1.sentence: The scheme is implemented by the Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises.

ctu2.sentence: It is designed to encourage self-employment and job creation in the country.
